name: notification-deep-links
goal: Every push a person would act on opens the most useful dashboard view or popup, gated by a repo test.

userStories.title: Transport fix and test scaffold (PR 1)
userStories.description: script.general_notification sends url and clickAction from one value and omits both when empty; tests/test_notification_deep_links.py builds the dashboard map from kohbo.yaml and checks declared links; missing links report-only.
acceptanceCriteria: With a url, the rendered push data holds url and clickAction with the same value
With url '' or absent, neither key is in the rendered data
tag, image, entity_id, push.interruption-level and actions render identically with and without a url (actions absent renders '')

The dashboard map is built by following !include from kohbo.yaml; known pairs (security-cameras#front_door_camera, climate#weather, sensors#zigbee_routers_popup) resolve and security#front_door_camera does not
Every declared dashboard link in packages/, automation/, scripts/, automations.yaml resolves to a view and popup in the map; a broken link fails the test
Pushes with no link produce one warning with the count and do not fail
No call site file is changed; full suite green; every new test has a sabotage run that goes red

userStories.title: Protection PR A: alarm and fire
userStories.description: Alarm triggered and disabled to security-alarm-panel; fire to security (url in the script.turn_on variables); shields-up status to security.
acceptanceCriteria: Each named push carries the stated link and the declared-link test passes
Critical priority and recipients of these pushes are unchanged
Alarm and fire regression suites stay green

userStories.title: Protection PR B: cameras
userStories.description: Derive the per-camera popup hash in camera_detection_alert.yaml (3 branches) from notifications_boolean; add camera on/off links.
acceptanceCriteria: The test expands every camera's derived link and each resolves to security-cameras#<camera>
Camera on and off pushes link to security-cameras

userStories.title: Protection PR C: leak
userStories.description: Add data: with a link to both leak alerts; extend test_leak_monitoring_regressions.py.
acceptanceCriteria: Both alerts carry url and clickAction pointing at security-leak-sensors
Leak regression tests assert the link

userStories.title: Protection PR D: doors, garage, locks, kids escape (BLOCKED on decision 6)
userStories.description: Link the unlinked door and garage pushes, upgrade lock alerts (including the garage evening autolock pushes) to the popup hash, link fingerprint, kids escape.
acceptanceCriteria: Blocked until John confirms which sensors the kids-escape alerts use
Each linked push resolves in the test

userStories.title: Phase 2 PR E: climate and weather
userStories.description: HVAC thermostat popups for eco/resume; climate#weather for NWS, UV and rain.
acceptanceCriteria: Each push carries its stated link and resolves

userStories.title: Phase 2 PR F: house and everyday
userStories.description: Laundry (including both direct washer callers), school, energy, vacation and away, holidays.
acceptanceCriteria: Each push carries its stated link and resolves
Washer recipient logic unchanged

userStories.title: Phase 2 PR G: system alerts
userStories.description: Zigbee router popup, radio/AP/watcher-down to sensors-offline.
acceptanceCriteria: Each push carries its stated link and resolves

userStories.title: Enforce the test and exempt list
userStories.description: Flip missing-link to a failure; add tests/fixtures/notification_url_exempt.yaml (path plus reason); stale-reason check; docs.
acceptanceCriteria: An unlinked call not on the exempt list fails
An exempt call that gains a url fails with a remove-from-list message

userStories.title: Needs-popup extras (dashboard-only)
userStories.description: Fire/smoke, UPS/power and radio health popups, each followed by a one-line PR swapping its interim link.
acceptanceCriteria: Each popup hash is in the view its link names and the test passes

metadata.note: One PR per task; PR 1 = task-1. Push pruning is a proposal and is out of scope.
